fml.menu.mods.info.description.origolds: Buffs vanilla golden gears, adds gilding system for your gears, revives the enchanted golden apple. M.G.G.A. for Make Gold Great Again!
tooltip.origolds.gilding_bonus: Gilding bonus: +%s%% durability, attack damage and mining speed
tooltip.origolds.gilding_ranged_bonus: Gilding bonus: +%s%% durability and arrow damage

tooltip.origolds.useful.origold_mold: Used with a Gold Block to cast an Origold Coatboard
tooltip.origolds.bs.origold_mold: "Heavy enough to crush your hopes, solid enough to build new ones."
tooltip.origolds.useful.compound_origold: Used with a Gold Block to cast a Compound Origold Coatboard
tooltip.origolds.bs.compound_origold_mol: "Now this is what I call 'industrial-grade efficiency'."
tooltip.origolds.useful.polyfusive_origo: Used with a Gold Block to cast a Polyfusive Origold Coatboard

tooltip.origolds.bs.compound_origold_coa: "Wealth is power, and I can feel it."
tooltip.origolds.useful.polyfusive_origo: Upgrades Gilded II gear to Gilded III
tooltip.origolds.bs.polyfusive_origold_c: "It's dull and shiny at the same time, looks like a graphical glitch."
tooltip.origolds.useful.magigold_core: Core crafting material for the OriGolds series
tooltip.origolds.bs.magigold_core: "This thing's manufacturing process is way ahead of its time."
tooltip.origolds.useful.origold_coating_: Required for OriGolds smithing table recipes
tooltip.origolds.bs.origold_coating_smit: "It looks like it didn't sign up for this. Relatable."
origolds.configuration.title: OriGolds Configuration
config.origolds.enable_gilding_effect.to: Controls whether gilded items show the golden filter effect.
Controls whether the gilding filter has a "breathing" gradient. Off means a static filter.
config.origolds.gradient_color.tooltip: Color of the gilding filter, as #RRGGBB (case-insensitive). Default: #FFFF00.
config.origolds.gradient_opacity.tooltip: Strength of the gilding filter, from 0.0 to 1.0. Default: 0.6.
command.origolds.gild.not_living: %s is not a living entity, so its held item cannot be modified
